title: Drone law dataset
description: A vendor-facing dataset of static drone rules. Live TFRs, airspace class, stadium schedules, and daylight times are supplied by the consumer.

schema_version.description: Dataset format version. Consumers should check this before parsing.

updated.description: Date the dataset was last updated.

license.description: License for the original dataset content.

notes.description: Caveats that apply to the whole dataset.

rules.description: Static rules. Consumers filter these by location and operation type.

id.description: Stable lowercase slug. Do not reuse an ID for a different rule.

jurisdiction.description: A place where a rule applies.

name.description: Display name, such as City of Columbus or Ohio.

source.description: Official source for the rule. Use label as the link text.

jurisdictions.description: One or more places where the rule applies. List several when the same rule covers multiple jurisdictions.

category.description: UI grouping. airspace covers altitude and controlled airspace; tfr covers temporary flight restrictions; stadium covers stadium events; state covers state-wide rules; local covers city, county, and park-district rules.

type.description: restriction renders as a warning; allowance renders as allowed; notice renders as information.

applies_to.description: all applies to any UAS operation; part-107 applies to Part 107 operations; recreational applies only to recreational operations.

scope.description: Human-readable area or condition where the rule applies.

title.description: Short heading for a card or list item.

message.description: Plain-language explanation of the rule, including the practical limit, exception, or action.

checked_on.description: Date the source was last checked.
